description: Reviewed historical citations for reference_crawler.py --strict, the G7 gate. Each entry names citing files that record a file at a commit on purpose, so the cited file's later interface drift is expected there. All other interface drift blocks. Add an entry only with a reason that a reviewer can check against the citing files.

entries.reason: 'The C296 dependency is fixed to commit 72edcf5b93be45c29f2d10a26f7d8e861a48f528'. The packet keeps its own byte-identical copy of the chart under project/.
Dated reviews: every directory name carries its date, and each records the cut it reviewed (cap_i4_d3_spectral_adapter_20261005/SOURCES.json: its source_cut field).
Its scientific_authority_map record says: 'historical source on a non-default branch; absent at the observed Main tip; not evidence of current authority'.
CBZ-0 evidence directories. Under GOVERNANCE.md B-003, delegated discovery writes only its assigned evidence directory, and each directory records what it observed at the commits it names.
'Math coverage ledger: retroactive artifact binding, 2026-10-23'. It links 'The frozen 33-URL source index'.
'That command was run successfully against source commit 2f7a5a9f10c9ed5f5b7792a8f2521318d9208532': the link records one run at that commit.
Its source-cut table says: 'These are dated identities, not assertions that branches will remain unchanged.'
The public mathematics catalog. Every sources-NN.md says: 'Each link opens the full retained public file at an immutable commit.' The sources-NN.json files are the same lists in JSON.
Dated reports: every directory name ends in the YYYYMMDD date of its observation.
Retrospective records. The drifting ones carry their date in the file name (_20261023, _20261026) or state the source cuts they read (the cuts field of GB-8w.agent5.node-candidates.json).
A timestamped observation (its observed_at field). docs/site/README.md: 'the same observation becomes stale after two hours', and the generated pages label it current, stale or clock disagreement.

Retained original bytes. docs/site/README.md: 'Original receipt/type/artifact bytes are retained under evidence/side24-main-3b39.' Its source bridges declare themselves an 'explicit source-identity bridge to a historical arithmetic artifact'.
Static node pages. docs/site/README.md: their 'Resume this node' block 'names the snapshot's graph commit, path, SHA-256 and observation time, and warns readers to refresh from the live record'.
docs/site/README.md: 'Research preserves its dated reading cuts and their source pins, with a separately identified current observation.'
Archived site snapshots, one directory per 64-hex digest, with their index. docs/site/README.md: 'Archived snapshot pages are unchanged.'
Dated intake directories: every directory name carries its YYYYMMDD date, and each IDENTITY.json records the sources it took in, by commit and SHA-256.
Dated reviews: every directory name carries its date, and each pins its sources at the reviewed head (sard_g_successor_a1_a6_20260926: 'pinned in the source map at the reviewed head').
Its dated 'Source-cut qualification, 7 October 2026' paragraph links 'a historical source at main ebedb780'.
Each artifact entry pins one version to an exact commit. meta-framework README: 'Changed source bytes need a new exact identity and an explicit scope, not erasure of the earlier experiment.'
Versioned byte-identical replicas (each directory name ends in -v1). Each SOURCE.json records the source commit its replica copies.
History stubs, each named by the commit it records (DOWNSTREAM_GATE_STUBS_<commit>.json).
